'''Lorand''' is a playable Unit in the game. He is one of the Four Heroes of Palmyna who fought alongside Edea, Loch and Dean against the malice of Cardes the Malevolent, one of the Four Fallen Gods.

==In-Game Appearance==
As an NPC character, Lorand's first appearance is in [[GQ:Palmyna|Grand Quest - Four Heroes of Palmyna]].

==Background==
He was a teacher in [[Palmyna:Light|Arlind Seminary]] as well as a former warrior well known for incinerating his enemies with his fire sword. He is also known as "The Inferno Gladiator".
